purpose: One-time isolated readiness audit; not a new per-release gate

broadPython.isolation: Private PID/proc namespace and private on-disk temporary directory
broadPython.skipPolicy: Explicit optional runtime, package, platform and external-environment requirements are not counted as passes. Useful warmed-Core controls receive separate source-bound qualification.
broadPython.limit: Later product changes use focused qualification; this result is not relabeled as a full run at a later commit.

checks: Expired and denied sign-in with actual login lifecycle and disposable child
Image preference inspection/configuration without model or image submission
Badge preference changes preserve pending Activity, decisions and private draft
limits: Synthetic provider and shortened sign-in deadline
No external account, image generation or OS notification acceptance

checks: Saved-version browse/reload and one explicit restore preserve exact runtime input receipts
All three ordinary layout values preserve the actual reading message and pixel offset, private draft and canonical conversation records
limits: Does not qualify universal external-effect replay or every narrow-layout reading position

checks: Final ordinary Settings, archive/search navigation and missing workspace folder controls
12 separately qualified optional Core checks and direct real history-edit probe
Failed Smart Tool stage cleanup and current-installation preservation

evidencePolicy: Current baseline observations, desired performance targets, ordinary route coverage and per-outcome coverage remain separate. Historical failures and all explicit limitations are retained in the private evidence ledger. Passing a suite does not qualify an unasserted outcome.
remaining: The exact ordinary-UX ledger and paired completed-corpus performance report govern final readiness. This test rollup does not declare every issue resolved.
